welcome:
`gYou step into the serene, incense-scented training space. Your Master stands with crossed arms in the middle of the mat.`w

"Welcome, traveler. I see you have fought in the forest. But are you truly ready for the next step?"
status_req: Required XP for Level {nextLvl}: `c{reqXp} XP`w (Current: `c{currentXp} XP`w)
ready: `2You are ready to fight for your next level!`w
not_ready: `4You haven't earned enough experience to challenge me yet. Train harder in the forest!`w
victory: `2Congratulations! You defeated your Master and ascend to Level {lvl}! Your max HP is permanently increased to {maxHp}.`w
defeat: `4Your Master beats you black and blue on the mat with a wooden training sword: "You are not ready yet, apprentice!" You barely survive, your HP is set to 1.`w
master_attack: strikes with a wooden practice sword
success_level_up: `2Congratulations! You defeated your Master in an epic battle and rose to Level {level}!`w
error_no_x_p: `4You are not ready yet! You do not have enough experience (XP) to challenge the Master.`w
skill_magic_success: `cYou cast the spell Regeneration! A mystic light surrounds you and heals {amount} HP.`w
skill_thieving_success: `yYou use your Pickpocket skill during the attack and rob {amount} extra gold pieces from the {enemy}!`w
skill_warrior_success:
`rYou execute a brute Shield Bash! You slam directly into the {enemy} and deal {amount} GUARANTEED damage!`w
The {enemy} is dazed!
arena_victory: `2You won the PvP duel and earned {gold} gold and {honor} honor!`w
arena_defeat: `4You were defeated in the PvP duel by {opponent}!`w
